generic_two_curve_unions.scope: Generic samples of arbitrary positive component sizes on two scaled three-pole curves have Theta(n^2) initial ideals. Special samples are not covered; no unrestricted G_3 improvement or novelty claim.

nongeneric_negative_control.obstruction: The first node on each component has y=1/2.

generic_multicurve_unions.scope: Uniform carrier and generic sampling-rank formulas for any number of scaled components. Balanced samples with r^2>=n have exactly the generic surface fan. Intermediate balanced counts and unrestricted G_3 remain unresolved; no novelty certificate.

balanced_hook_threshold_charging.scope: Uniform O(n^2*log(n+1)) balanced multicomponent fan bound. Threshold charges share a monotone rank interval across all carrier sectors. The general unequal-size and unrestricted G_3 counts remain open; priority is not certified.

phase_controls.scope: A fixed carrier-flag domain has the same positive greedy outputs as a classical nested matroid. This is not an identification of the full residue matroid on arbitrary subsets or a fan-count bound.

hook_capacity_compression.scope: Only size drops greater than two can supply additional capacity constraints; combine this exact reduction with the earlier square-root cutoff. With no such drops, uniform carrier truncation and the existing quadratic-power fan bound apply. Diagonal-hook facts are classical; no unrestricted bound or exact priority claim.

rank_limit.scope: An explicit O(r) finite error proves the linear-profile rank limit and its curvature transition at slope four. Rank loss and many cost phases do not count coherent initial ideals or establish a polynomial fan separation.

layer_wall_counting.scope: All positive wall curves of formal independent layer selection are checked. The uniform arithmetic filter and piece count prove an upper bound; these fixtures are not full point-ideal fan counts.

point_ideals.scope: Separate weights in one actual finite point ideal verify the layer decomposition. Invertible bases and strictly lower vanishing border relations prove the initials by equal colength. No complete fan or arbitrary-subset matroid identification.

steep_component_profiles.scope: Sufficiently steep gaps give every singleton phase and an exact positive layer sum. An arithmetic wall-curve argument bounds all all-tight selections by O(n^2) for fixed linear profiles, including all axis orders and aspects. Pooled phases and unrestricted G_3 remain open.

pooled_component_blocks.scope: Complete one-dimensional trace, not a whole fan. Short-block rank-q and rank-(q-1) signatures, critical walls, compact and global logarithmic line-curve branches and integer-product counts are checked. Three actual pooled bases have exact point certificates. Uniform bounded-width theorems are proved separately.

three_drop_capacity_reduction.scope: The uniform proof strengthens the old drop-two reduction: only adjacent size drops greater than three can add capacity constraints. The drop-four critical family below makes this universal integer threshold sharp. This does not settle unrestricted G_3.

point_ideal.scope: Invertible evaluation basis and strict vanishing border relations certify this actual initial ideal. Raw evaluation independently gives the rank defect. All 70 critical four-subsets agree with the shifted auxiliary matroid in this fixture; that finite agreement is not a uniform identification of arbitrary residue subsets.

critical_harmonic_rotation.scope: Exact harmonic-curve identities, odd-last-size endpoint collapse, complete exceptional-unit samples for even last size, and independent generic-prefix ranks. The rank defect and a final canonical block both grow linearly with r in a proved infinite family. The auxiliary critical rule is the established shifted matroid SM(2,4,...,2r), a minor of C_(r+1); its Catalan number of feasible bases is not a count of coherent initial ideals. No full two-parameter critical-neighborhood or unrestricted G_3 bound is claimed.

subcritical_final_surface_prefixes.scope: All-field generic-component rank model, with explicit subcritical capacity localization and an eventual final-surface-prefix collapse criterion uniform over all positive aspects. Large matrix-free integer witnesses exercise the compact-gap and both extreme-sigma branches; independent heaps and three actual point bases are separate controls. Critical final-prefix dependencies grow as sqrt(n), but neither they nor the narrowing exceptional strip count the remaining coherent states. No unrestricted G_3 improvement or novelty certificate.

critical_support_energy_caps.scope: Independent heap/quota bases versus exact floor-rank integration, including bounded irregular perturbations of slope four; outward rational square-root bounds; exact profile-cap, Hessian and nonunimodular volume controls; generalized final-prefix collapse, weighted dyadic covers and planar degeneracies; three actual point-basis certificates. These support a uniform proof using classical Andrews geometry. They are not whole-fan enumerations or a novelty certificate.

higher_slope_boundary_proximity.scope: Exact layerwise proximity, pooling-energy and compressed staircase controls, including irregular gaps, lex ties and heavy last components. The compressed algorithm has a global exchange certificate and independent skyline colength/profile checks. Known nested resource-allocation algorithms already avoid expansion in total resources; this is a specialized arithmetic-stream reduction, not a new general optimization class or a universal G_3 theorem.

transition_boundary_interactions.scope: The classical bounded-degree lattice-point estimate gives a uniform O(L^3 H^2 + V L H) arrangement bound for small-y-coefficient lines truncated near a harmonic curve. This controls the same-type exchange network in the intermediate regime, not the complete fan. Exact boundary signatures fail to determine the optimum even after both same-type orders are fixed: a length-54 actual point ideal has a strict mixed row-column wall. This finite obstruction does not prove an asymptotic lower separation or settle unrestricted G_3.
